root_idea.summary: The root centers on reinforcement: a support or strengthening element, extending to personal aid, assistance, and mutual support.
root_idea.development: The concrete image is a buttress or attached support for a wall; this develops into the senses of helping, aiding, and supplying support. Related forms also record badness and, under separately headed forms, ruin or destruction.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested noun with a distinct lexical entry and a securely normalized citation form.

senses.definition: A helper, aide, or supporting associate who accompanies another to assist him.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the رِدْء is one sent with another to support and aid him, specifically to help confirm his speech. This sense denotes personal assistance, not the separate concrete sense of a wall-buttress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prop or strengthen a wall, person, or thing by means of an attached structure or other aid; hence, to help or assist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verb of supporting one thing or person by means of another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take good care of camels by tending and pasturing them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast or throw a stone at someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct transitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be bad, corrupt, vicious, depraved, low, vile, or weak and impotent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing or a person according to the cited lexical descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To settle, establish, or confirm a person or thing in its state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV transitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To still or quiet a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To let down a veil or curtain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a veil or curtain in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render something bad, corrupt, vicious, or depraved, or to declare or hold it to be bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative or evaluative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do a bad deed, or to encounter or experience something bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form IV construction concerning an act or an experienced event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed a stated age or number of years.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported with عَلَى in expressions such as exceeding fifty, sixty, or one hundred; this usage is disputed, and an alternative form is preferred by some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To help, aid, or assist one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A buttress or similar structure by which a wall is strengthened and supported.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a physical supporting structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing by which another is helped, aided, or assisted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An inanimate or abstract means of assistance, distinct from the Quranic personal helper sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An accession, addition, or supplementary element supplied to another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for something added as reinforcement or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A load paired with another load to balance it on the opposite side of a pack animal; also, a heavy load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use based on one load supporting or balancing another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bad, corrupt, vicious, depraved, low, ignoble, vile, or mean; also weak and impotent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to things or people; its plural is used of a group of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Worse or worst; more or most corrupt or vile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone so large that a strong man can scarcely lift it with both hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related form مِرْدَاةٌ is also reported for this meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Destruction, ruin, or perdition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately headed related form, not an additional meaning of رِدْءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To expose oneself to destruction, or to perish and fall into ruin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately headed related verbal form used for falling into destruction.

cautions: The reported meaning of أَرْدَأَ as “to exceed” is lexically disputed and is retained with that restriction.
The destruction meanings رَدَى and تَرَدَّى are listed under their own related headwords and are not assigned to the Quranic noun رِدْءٌ.
